_meta.description: Add a text document to a Claude Project's knowledge base. For Google Drive docs: export the content as text first (see STATUS file). Invoke once per document; loop at caller level for multiple docs.
_meta.verificationNotes: Built 2026-05-21. The knowledge base 'Add content' dialog UI must be verified on a live project. Claude.ai may present different modal structures; perceive steps capture the actual tree. File upload path via js action is stubbed — text paste is the primary flow.
anomalies: Google Drive doc URLs cannot be directly added as URL references — claude.ai knowledge base (as of mid-2025) only accepts file uploads and text paste. Use 03b-gdrive-extract.payload.json (future) or pass exported text as content_text.
File upload via browser file input requires a local file path and a js action shim — stubbed in this payload; text paste is V1 primary path.
The 'Add content' dialog may be a slide-over sheet rather than a dialog element — perceive step captures actual structure.

project_url.description: Full URL of the target Claude Project (https://claude.ai/project/<uuid>)
project_url.hint: Returned by 02-create-project as the final URL in project_page_state

content_text.description: Raw text content to paste into the knowledge base. Use this for text/markdown/exported Google Drive content.
content_text.hint: If both content_text and file_path are empty, the payload will fail at the insert step.

doc_title.description: Title/name for the document in the knowledge base (if the UI offers a title field)

file_path.description: STUB — local file path for file upload (PDF, DOCX, TXT). V1 text paste only; file upload shim is not yet wired.
file_path.hint: Leave empty unless you know file upload is implemented

add_content_button.description: Button in the project knowledge panel to open the add-content dialog

paste_text_option.description: Option inside the add-content dialog to paste/type text (as opposed to file upload)

knowledge_text_input.description: Textarea or contenteditable where document text is pasted

knowledge_title_input.description: Optional title/name field for the document being added

save_knowledge_button.description: Button to save/confirm the new knowledge document

chain.note: Navigate directly to the target project
Let project page load including knowledge panel
Fail fast if project_url led somewhere unexpected
Capture full project page to locate knowledge panel and Add content button
Open Add content dialog. If this fails, check perceive output — button may be labeled differently.
Capture the dialog structure — which tabs/options are available (Upload, Paste, URL, etc.)
Select the 'Paste text' / text tab option within the dialog
Fill title field if present — target resolution will skip if element not found
Paste/type the document content into the textarea
Click Save/Done. Response signature watches for success toast or confirmation element.
Capture knowledge panel state to confirm the document appears in the list
